English:
Hey guys, wanna go hang
out in the forest south of Totus?
I approve! It's been such a long time.

Somehow, I'm *sure*
we have better things to do.

Actually, I think this is a
good time to check on Yggdrasill.

Right, right! So no being
stuffy, Mr. Fuddy-Duddy, okay?
Well, if everyone insists, then so be it.
...But let's at least make it quick.
